yield.ex: The fields yield a rich harvest each autumn.
yield.mnemonic: yield – khet mein fasal yield deti hai, ya haar maano

yielding.definition: giving way easily; flexible or submissive
yielding.ex: The yielding cushion sank under his weight.
yielding.mnemonic: yielding – field mein soft mitti aasani se dab jaati

youthful.ex: He has a youthful energy despite his age.
youthful.mnemonic: youthful – youth full, jawani se bhara hua

young.definition: having lived for only a short time
young.ex: The young athlete broke a national record last week.
young.mnemonic: young – yaar aaj bhi jawan feel karta hai

you snooze, you lose.definition: if you miss chance, you lose it
you snooze, you lose.ex: Last benches were free, but he slept; you snooze, you lose.

yeoman's service.definition: loyal and helpful work for long time

yard.mnemonic: yard – ghar ke aage khula aangan, yaad rakho
